_metadata.description: Durable jobs and reproducible recovery. Fresh product contract; all behavior remains unimplemented.

requirements.title: The job service shall retain durable attempts and receipts.
requirements.description: The job service shall persist queued/running/terminal state, owned child attempts, immutable inputs, progress, errors and output receipts before acknowledging durable transitions.

validation.notes: NOT EXECUTED. Follow the named DS-JOB-DURABILITY protocol, including its counterexample, and retain actual inputs, commands, receipts, results and reviewer verdict. The protocol is a verification plan, not passing evidence.

requirements.title: The job service shall cancel only owned work.
requirements.description: When cancellation is requested, the job service shall stop future submissions, terminate owned local process trees, request supported remote cancellation and retain partial output and reconciliation status.

validation.notes: NOT EXECUTED. Follow the named DS-JOB-CANCEL protocol, including its counterexample, and retain actual inputs, commands, receipts, results and reviewer verdict. The protocol is a verification plan, not passing evidence.

metadata.planned_automation: Ownership isolation, process cleanup and cancellation fault injection.

requirements.title: The job service shall handle bounded failure and retry.
requirements.description: If disk-full, tool failure, invalid output, timeout or restart occurs, the job service shall retain a recoverable state, avoid publishing partial files as final and retry only safe units under the original clock and budget.

validation.notes: NOT EXECUTED. Follow the named DS-JOB-RECOVERY protocol, including its counterexample, and retain actual inputs, commands, receipts, results and reviewer verdict. The protocol is a verification plan, not passing evidence.

metadata.planned_automation: Disk/tool/output failure injection and checkpoint replay tests.

requirements.title: The cache shall validate the complete render dependency key.
requirements.description: Before reusing output or a fixed-scene plate, the cache shall compare relevant source/time, asset/UV/rig, scene/light/camera/mask, strategy, renderer/build and color/profile dependencies and reject stale or incompatible entries.

validation.notes: NOT EXECUTED. Follow the named DS-JOB-CACHE protocol, including its counterexample, and retain actual inputs, commands, receipts, results and reviewer verdict. The protocol is a verification plan, not passing evidence.

metadata.planned_automation: Cache invalidation/property tests and stationary replacement comparison.

requirements.title: The job service shall reconcile logical work and paid attempts.
requirements.description: The job service shall retain parent/attempt/upstream operation and reservation IDs and reconcile status/usage after retry, restart or lost acknowledgment without double-charging one executed operation.

validation.notes: NOT EXECUTED. Follow the named DS-JOB-ACCOUNTING protocol, including its counterexample, and retain actual inputs, commands, receipts, results and reviewer verdict. The protocol is a verification plan, not passing evidence.

metadata.planned_automation: Accounting replay/reconciliation fault injection against owner mocks and later capped integration.
